scenes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one beautiful finished landscape illustration for a Japanese graded-reading story, Kasa Jizo. Image 1 is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE, not an edit target. Match its hand-painted gouache picture-book style, fine paper grain, subtle brushwork, natural anatomy, expressive gentle faces and believable materials. The same elderly Japanese man: slender, weathered kind face, grey hair in a small topknot, indigo padded coat over a grey-blue kimono, rust-red scarf, brown trousers. Restrained ivory, indigo, sage, ochre and terracotta palette. Original folk-tale character designs. Landscape 12:7 composition, ideally 1536x896. Full-bleed painting, no border, no lettering, no captions, no watermarks. Beautiful legible scene even displayed at 360px wide. Avoid flat vector shapes, crude geometry, exaggerated cartoon faces, glossy 3D, abstract hands, duplicated fingers. Scene: inside a humble traditional Japanese mountain cottage during a winter afternoon, the old man sits on the wooden floor finishing a woven straw hat in his lap. Exactly FIVE hats total: ONE unfinished conical straw hat held naturally by his two hands, and FOUR completed straw hats neatly arranged beside him so their separate brims can be counted. A modest bundle of loose straw on the floor, simple timber beams and a small wooden lattice window overlooking snow and distant evergreens. He wears a pale cotton head towel tied around his forehead with the little grey topknot visible. Warm soft daylight catches golden straw and his thoughtful face. Three-quarter view with the man left of centre and the completed hats on the right. No other people, no food, no statues. Show real interwoven straw texture without fussy visual clutter. This is the quiet hopeful beginning, not a celebration.

jobs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit the supplied Kasa Jizo illustration into a slightly more cartoonish, less textured version for inline story art. Preserve the exact scene, composition, character identities, clothing colours, object counts and warm Japanese folk-tale atmosphere. Keep the landscape 12:7 framing. Art direction: polished hand-drawn storybook illustration, gently rounded expressive faces, simplified but convincing natural anatomy and hands, elegant thin warm-brown contour accents, broad clean gouache colour areas, soft restrained shading. Keep painterly warmth and depth but reduce surface texture by about 80 percent: nearly smooth fabric, a few intentional wood-grain marks, simple straw pattern suggestions, quiet background detail. Simplify the wrinkles and individual hairs without making the elderly people look young. Slightly cartoonish, not chibi or caricature; no oversized heads or anime eyes. More character warmth, less photographic realism. Do not turn the picture into geometric vector clip art, cel-shaded plastic, a flat icon or 3D rendering. Maintain the muted indigo, rust, ochre, sage, warm ivory and blue-grey palette. Nothing new should be added. No text, lettering, borders or watermarks. Invariants: ONE elderly man sitting at left making ONE hat in his lap; exactly FOUR other finished hats on the floor at right (FIVE total), loose straw, snowy daylight through the cottage window. Indigo coat, rust scarf, grey topknot with pale cotton head towel. Keep the hat in his hands distinct from the completed hats. Use clear, believable fingers and a few curved weaving lines instead of densely rendering every straw.
